evidence: The physical properties of the ﬁlm are similar to published results ~Table I!. The values shown in Table I are for a process optimized for low leakage current and high breakdown voltage, but the ﬁlm properties, deposition rate, and within wafer nonuniformity are fairly invariant with process conditions, for ﬁlms deposited in the ALD mode at deposition temperatures of 150-300°C. The CH3 groups are removed from the ALD AlOx by using H2O as the oxidant because the C content in the ﬁlms is at the detectable limits of Auger analysis. The ﬁlms are stoichiometric within the resolution of Auger spectroscopy ~Fig. 5! even at deposition temperatures as low as 200°C. The H content is ;5 atom %, consistent with literature reports. 11 The changing H content reportedly causes refractive index to increase from 1.64 to 1.68 as the deposition temperature increases from 250 to 400°C.
